steps: Just as the truth of the case comes to light… a new request suddenly appears?!
We arrive at our final destination: the hot pot restaurant. Immediately, we are surrounded by a sharp, spicy aroma.
According to the route they took, after shopping for groceries, they came here for dinner ...==W== Achoo!
Achoo, achoo! Achoo, achoo! I can't stop sneezing...!
Sorry, I forgot. Most visitors—==W== Achoo! aren't used to the smell of Cangwu hot pot.
It's fine, it's just—==W== Achoo!==W== Just spice!
E-excuse me, could we get a table somewhere with good ventilation? Some of us aren't used to the smell ...==W== Achoo!
We're seated by the window, where the spicy smell isn't nearly as strong.
Phew ... It's me who should be thanking you...
What did I do? Why is she thanking me...? Shimiao's a local. This level of spice shouldn't bother her, right?
Looks like it's your first time here Would you like some recommendations?
A group of Xuan Shi came here yesterday afternoon. We want the exact same dishes that they ordered.
It's just that ... The Xuan Shi group yesterday ordered our extra spicy hot pot base, so please be careful.
Bo-Boss, seriously, don't force yourself! I'm ... at least sort of used to it.==B== But if we want to retrace their steps yesterday, there's no way around it!
Shimiao's voice is trembling a bit. Is she not feeling well?
Thanks for waiting—! Here's our signature dish: the "Heaven-and-Hell Ultimate Spicy Hot Pot"—!
...==W== I can do this. The Baize model employee can't let everyone else down ...==B== No matter how spicy, I'll eat it...! Here we go...!
I'm the Boss! And I shall not be defeated by mere spices...! Here we go...!
We both pick up some of the bright red, spicy food at the same time.
Phew ... Thank you, bubble tea, for bringing me back to life...
Ugh…==W== Hiccup!==W== Uhh…==W== I can todally handle...==W== a lil spice==W== like dis...
SO spicy! Waah!==W== Eek...==W== Ugh...==W== Whooo ordered==W== dis hot pot...
Wuz id you Boss?==W== Id wuz, wuzn id?==W== You can'd fool me!==W== Hiccup!
Issooo spicy!==W== Bud==W== I love it!!!!!
Drung?==W== Uhh... Hiccup!==W== Who, me?==W== Of courz I'm nod!
Lissen up.==W== You know==W== dat Baize Byoo-roh?==W== I am da most bestest…==W== model?==W== employee of them!
Okay, I get it! Just don't push yourself!
Push myself?==W== Uuh…==W== I'm not!==W== I …==W== am not…==W== Am not…
Waaaaaah!==W== I'm not pushing myself!==W== AM NOT!!
Get a grip! Seriously, are you okay?
I...==W== I==W== wanna meed erryone's expecdations…==W== So I always worked my hardest…
And==W== when I do good job,==W== errryone says==W== "oh wow,==W== nice job, Shimiao"==W== and then they trust me more...
That's why …==W== I can't let everyone down…==W== I have to work harder, harder, harder,==W== and even harder…
But!==W== Who'm I supposed to asg for help==W== when I need it?!
Aw, it's okay! Shimiao, you're a good girl.
Heh...==W== Hehe...==W== I got praised by Boss ♪
Iss like==W== I'm always da one takin' care of people…==W== But get praised like dis…==W== I'm truly,==W== incredibly happy~
Maybe it's sheer exhaustion, or maybe it's just spice from the hot pot hits like a few too many drinks ... But Shimiao falls fast asleep right on the table.
She wakes up only twenty minutes later.
Oh no ... I totally lost my composure in front of you, Boss, ugh...
It's fine. I'm just glad I got to see this secret side of you, Shimiao.
Don't worry, it's not some big secret.
She's always so tense in public. Letting her true self slipping out is just the kind of break she needs.
Besides, it's not a bad secret at all ...==B== It just makes you more approachable.
Approachable ... Since it's you who said it, I'll buy it.
You sound even cuter after eating spicy food. If it's alright with you...
I'd like to see more of this side of you.
R-really...?==B== There's nothing special about seeing me like this, though...
You're hardworking, earnest ... A little awkward, but really kind. And getting to know this adorable side of you is such a treat.
I think maybe your colleagues notice how tightly wound you are, too.==B== So why not relax a little at work and let more of your real self show?
I always thought my coworkers and everyone else treated me so well because they saw me as a "perfect" employee...
But knowing there's someone—like you, Boss—who feels this way about me ... Even if it's just one person ... that actually feels pretty nice—
Sorry for intruding, but here's your second serving of "Heaven-and-Hell Ultimate Spicy Hot Pot!"
What!!! Why's there another one of these?! Are you sure you got the right table...?
I am sure. The Xuan Shi group yesterday thought one hot pot wasn't enough, so they ordered another one plus a whole bunch of extra dishes.

Staring at the mountain of food in front of us, both Shimiao and I fall silent. Still, we can't let any of it go to waste. So after eating as much as we possibly can, we pack up what's left to take home.
Phew ... After checking everywhere yesterday, we found that all the food from each shop was fine, no hygiene issues at all.
But ... Whew ...==B== After eating that hot pot, I think I know what happened.
Of the sheer volume of food. All of them ate at least double portions.
Then they went home and cooked up some late-night snack with all those groceries. Just how much did they end up eating in one night?
So much food, and so spicy—no wonder they got sick ... We barely ate any compared to them, and we're still feeling it the next day...
And with that, the commission wrapped up perfectly. But also...
Boss, I have a long-term commission I'd like you to take on for me.
Yeah? No need to beat around the bush, hit me.
Could you ... help me train how to handle spicy food?
I know you said that I'm kind of cute when I eat spicy food ... But I can't just get "drunk" on it every time. I really want to get better at handling it...!
I get what you mean, Boss, when you say that I don't have to push myself too hard...
But even so, as the "model employee," I still want to do my best.==B== Besides, you said it yourself, I sound pretty cute after eating spicy food.
I see. If this is your way of relaxing, I'm happy to join you.==B== But are you sure I'm the person for it? My spice tolerance is...
Yeah. In fact ... You're the only one I'd want to do this with, because, Boss—
—You also look really cute with your cheeks all red after eating spicy food!
